improvements.reason: Gold publication is atomic: a failure after retiring old current rows rolls back retirement and all partial inserts, retaining the prior successful client-program run. Valid payload cells and calculated figures are unchanged.

The durable manifest repository and Gold reads share one destination. An accepted run is discoverable after restart; the recording harness's disconnected in-memory latest-run 404 is not reproduced. HTTP mapping belongs to W2.

ClientIdentity.Parse explicitly refuses identifiers outside positive Int64 range before SQL execution. W2 maps the application refusal to a JSON detail-family 422 instead of reproducing the Python binding overflow's plain-text 500.

Duplicate storage identities are explicit repository conflicts, while new identities can append legitimate same-cell history and close the former live row. W2 must implement duplicate-create request idempotency or 409; this does not claim HTTP duplicate-body handling is already built.
